name: kabane-monorepo
description: Kabane — local-first issue tracker and kanban for humans and AI agent runtimes

scripts.check: bun run layers && bun run lint && bun run fmt:check && bun run quality
scripts.quality: bun run knip && bun run duplicates
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter '*' typecheck && node node_modules/tsgo/bin/tsc --noEmit -p scripts
scripts.test: bun test packages/questions packages/checklist packages/handoff packages/outcome packages/registry ./packages/work packages/core packages/sqlite packages/acp packages/extension packages/cli packages/board extensions scripts && bun run --cwd packages/worker test
scripts.test:bun: bun test packages/questions packages/checklist packages/handoff packages/outcome packages/registry ./packages/work packages/core packages/sqlite packages/acp packages/extension packages/cli packages/board extensions scripts
